notes: family = factor family; buckets = bucket-weight set (FAMILY_BUCKETS in factor_oscillator.py); beta = beta vs Nifty 50 (NSE Index Dashboard), scales the C4 macro import; vix = direction of the X3 regime indicator ('risk' = high VIX is a headwind, 'contra' = high VIX is a cheap entry); parent = size universe the index is drawn from; funds = example index funds / ETFs tracking it. anchors override [cheap, rich] per indicator. sector_map maps NSE factsheet sectors to nifty-sectors-config.json keys for the X1/X2 look-through.
